category.name: Roofing, Tech & Sci-Fi
category.description: Slate, shake, barrel and fishscale roofing, PCBs, solar arrays, sci-fi hull plating, heatsinks and acoustic foam.

materials.name: Heatsink Extrusion Fins
materials.description: Tight extruded aluminum electronics heatsink cooling fin array. Extruded cooling fin arrays.

projection.tiling_note: Fins run along V; align them with the extrusion direction.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.15 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.15 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Fins clog with dust between blades.

materials.name: Solar Cell Grid
materials.description: Monocrystalline solar panel cells with silver busbars & micro-fingers. Photovoltaic cells with silver busbars and white backsheet gaps.

projection.tiling_note: Planar UVs, one tile per 0.62 m cell block; cover with glossy glass coat.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.6 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.6 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Panels collect dust and bird grime; clean panels are glossy.

materials.name: PCB Solder Mask Traces
materials.description: Electronics PCB surface with parallel copper traces & micro-vias. Solder-masked FR4 boards with copper traces, vias and gold pads.

projection.tiling_note: Planar UVs on flat boards at true 0.1 m scale.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.1 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.1 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Electronics gather dust; oxidize pads only for abandoned props.

materials.name: Acoustic Pyramid Foam
materials.description: Studio/packaging convoluted acoustic pyramid foam micro-peaks. Absorbent open-cell acoustic treatment panels.

projection.tiling_note: Planar UVs at the 0.5 m panel scale.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.5 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.5 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Foam fades and gathers dust on peaks.

materials.name: Natural Slate Roof
materials.description: Natural blue-black slate roof. Overlapping roof coverings with shadowed laps.

projection.tiling_note: Keep the texture upright on the roof plane: image top toward the ridge, image bottom toward the eave, so course overlaps shade correctly.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1.5 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 1.2 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Roofs grow moss on shaded slopes and streak below ridges.
